input: Fix the title tag, meta description, and heading structure on this page for its target keyword.
notes: On-page elements (titles, headings) must select on-page-seo, not the technical foundations skill.

input: Diagnose why Googlebot struggles to crawl my JavaScript-heavy pages and fix the crawlability and mobile rendering problems.
notes: Crawlability and rendering problems must select technical-seo, not on-page-seo.

input: Draft an in-depth, research-backed long-form article explaining sourdough fermentation.
notes: A long-form explainer must select article-writing, not persuasive copywriting.

input: Write landing page copy with a headline and call to action that converts visitors into trial signups.
notes: Conversion copy (headline + call to action) must select copywriting, not article-writing.

input: Which search queries should my baking blog target? Evaluate search volume and difficulty for candidate keywords.
notes: Choosing which queries to target is keyword research, not SERP analysis of one query.

input: For the query best sourdough starter kit, who ranks on the first page and what SERP features appear?
notes: Analyzing who ranks for one query is SERP analysis, not keyword discovery.

input: Add Article and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD markup to my blog post template.
notes: Implementing markup on one template is schema-jsonld, not the site-wide structured-data strategy skill.

input: Plan which schema types each template on my site needs and how to keep markup accurate as content changes.
notes: Site-wide schema strategy is structured-data, not the single-page schema-jsonld implementation skill.

input: My product pages are heavy with images; choose modern formats, resize to displayed size, and lazy-load below the fold.
notes: Full image optimization (formats, sizing, lazy-loading) is image-optimization, not the narrower image-compression skill.

input: Choose between summary and summary_large_image card types and add the twitter:card meta tags for my articles.
notes: X-specific card tags must select twitter-cards, not the general open-graph skill.

input: Set up Open Graph tags so my pages render rich link previews on Facebook, LinkedIn, and Slack, including og:type and og:url.
notes: Multi-platform Open Graph previews must select open-graph, not the X-only twitter-cards skill.

input: This published article is outdated and losing traffic — update its facts and re-optimize it instead of rewriting from scratch.
notes: Updating an existing page in place is content-refresh, not repurposing into new formats.

input: Turn my best article into social posts, a newsletter, and an infographic to reach new audiences.
notes: Adapting one piece into many formats is content-repurposing, not refreshing the original.

input: Search engines are not finding my new pages; build a sitemap and control crawling with robots.txt.
notes: Discovery: a crawl-coverage task must surface sitemap-robots in the top 3.
